 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. India head into the second T20I at Hagley Oval on Saturday, October 24, with a 1-0 series lead and a few selection questions still to answer.
 The hosts, meanwhile, will be keen to hit back on a ground that produced more than 450 runs in the opening game.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The biggest talking point is the absence of Ishan Kishan, who has been ruled out with a groin strain. His exit is expected to bring Vaibhav Sooryavanshi back into the XI after he missed the West Indies T20Is and Thursday's series opener.
